contact_properties.name: industry
contact_properties.label: Industry
contact_properties.description: The industry vertical of the contact's business

contact_properties.name: city
contact_properties.label: City
contact_properties.description: The city where the contact's business is located

contact_properties.name: monthly_leads_volume
contact_properties.label: Monthly Leads Volume
contact_properties.description: The estimated number of leads the contact's business receives per month

contact_properties.name: number_of_locations
contact_properties.label: Number of Locations
contact_properties.description: The number of physical business locations the contact operates

contact_properties.name: current_software
contact_properties.label: Current Software
contact_properties.description: The software or tools the contact currently uses to manage their business

contact_properties.name: pricing_tier
contact_properties.label: Pricing Tier
contact_properties.description: The CWI AI pricing tier the contact is on or being quoted

contact_properties.name: monthly_fee
contact_properties.label: Monthly Fee
contact_properties.description: The monthly recurring fee (in dollars) the contact pays for CWI AI services

contact_properties.name: setup_fee_collected
contact_properties.label: Setup Fee Collected
contact_properties.description: Indicates whether the one-time setup fee has been collected from the contact

contact_properties.name: go_live_date
contact_properties.label: Go Live Date
contact_properties.description: The date the contact's CWI AI bot went live and was activated for their business

contact_properties.name: nps_score
contact_properties.label: NPS Score
contact_properties.description: The contact's most recent Net Promoter Score (0-10) from a satisfaction survey

contact_properties.name: last_check_in
contact_properties.label: Last Check-In
contact_properties.description: The date of the most recent check-in or touchpoint with this contact

contact_properties.name: support_tickets_month
contact_properties.label: Support Tickets This Month
contact_properties.description: The number of support tickets submitted by this contact in the current month

contact_properties.name: containment_rate
contact_properties.label: Containment Rate
contact_properties.description: The percentage of conversations handled by the bot without requiring human escalation, for this contact's account

company_properties.name: cwi_last_report_month
company_properties.label: CWI Last Report Month
company_properties.description: The month (e.g., 'May 2026') of the most recent performance report sent to this company

company_properties.name: cwi_total_conversations
company_properties.label: CWI Total Conversations
company_properties.description: The total number of bot conversations handled for this company in the reporting period

company_properties.name: cwi_bot_resolved
company_properties.label: CWI Bot Resolved
company_properties.description: The number of conversations fully resolved by the bot without human intervention

company_properties.name: cwi_containment_rate
company_properties.label: CWI Containment Rate
company_properties.description: The percentage of total conversations resolved by the bot (bot resolved / total conversations) for this company

company_properties.name: cwi_escalation_rate
company_properties.label: CWI Escalation Rate
company_properties.description: The percentage of conversations that required escalation to a human agent for this company

company_properties.name: cwi_appointments_booked
company_properties.label: CWI Appointments Booked
company_properties.description: The number of appointments booked through the CWI AI bot for this company in the reporting period

company_properties.name: cwi_avg_response_time
company_properties.label: CWI Avg Response Time
company_properties.description: The average bot response time in seconds for this company during the reporting period

company_properties.name: cwi_report_sent_date
company_properties.label: CWI Report Sent Date
company_properties.description: The date the most recent performance report was sent to this company

instructions: Create these properties in HubSpot Settings > Properties. Contact properties go under Contacts, Company properties under Companies. For enumeration types, create each option exactly as listed. These property names are referenced in Make.com scenarios C, H, N, O.
